params.body:
A gap in yesterday's coverage, found by checking the production flag rather than the test one.

Halfway through a login the user is still a guest, so `Auth::user()` is null. `RequireFeature` looks the user up from `login.id` before asking the flag, which is what makes a per-dealer release work for the second step at all. Nothing pinned that for the challenge by mail, and every test around it runs with `two_factor` on `everyone` (config/features.php in the test environment) — the one stage where that difference cannot show. Production has the flag on `dealers`.

So this stands the flag where production has it, released to a single dealer, and reads both sides of the line: a user of that dealer reaches his challenge (by mail and by app), a user of another dealer does not, and no mail leaves for him.

Worth saying what the mutation showed, because it is not what I first assumed: losing that lookup does not close the door, it opens it too wide. The middleware falls back to its reading for a route with no user at all (on unless the stage is `off`), so every dealer would reach a challenge released to one. The boundary test is the one that fails; the two "opens" tests keep passing. The docblock says so.

Tests only, no behaviour change. Full suite green.
params.title: The challenge knows who is halfway
